title: research.multi cannot do what a reporter's assignment asks: snippets are its only evidence
description: docs/automated-publication-research-workflow.md:252 says: fetching pages is not part of this mode; snippets are the evidence, so every claim is a lead to verify. stories assign-research defaults to this type, labelled research-mode source_discovery. An editor's direction can ask for primary sources to be read, as the non-interference assignment does, and nothing tells them the run cannot do that. Either add a mode that fetches and reads sources, or say plainly in the Assign research box and the CLI what the run will and will not do.
